content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service), which is provider liability and cannot be billed to the patient. The retro-auth window is closed, no peer-to-peer is offered, and resubmitting would trigger a CO-18 duplicate denial. An appeal was already filed with no payer response, and there is no new information request to answer, so no payer-facing action can properly recover this balance.","action":"write_off"}
